entities.name: Francisco Javier de Cienfuegos y Jovellanos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Javier de Cienfuegos y Jovellanos was a Spanish bishop and cardinal. He was born in Oviedo. He was bishop of Cádiz (1819–1824) and archbishop of Seville (1824–1847).
